title: 23.56. Sanidassanattika, Atītattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasanidassanasappaṭigho napaccuppanno dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa paccuppannassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā cha, anantare samanantare tīṇi, upanissaye cha, natthiyā vigate tīṇi.
